scope: Original bundled adult museum, wood and unlettered book-stack stands with same-scene preview/apply/cancel. Canonical existing edition-specific frames remain the default and a distinct sentinel.
compositionBoundary: Preview changes only the stand. Other scene/semantic owners remain authoritative. Apply commits the session stand; confirmation failure preserves that applied choice with retry. This is not strict whole-composition persist-or-rollback or store/rights approval.
requiredChecks: actual transformed geometry bounds and disposal
native Back and surface crossing cancellation
